mods.name: Deck Suggestions
mods.author: eruizimade
mods.summary: What to play next, worked out on the deck: fit, stars, key, tempo, energy and MyTag filters. No computer.
mods.description:
Load a track and a panel shows the six best follow-ups with fit, stars, BPM, key, genre, why, rekordbox's waveform and the letters to type in SEARCH, worked out on the deck from what Backspins (the rekordbox toolkit) wrote to your drive. Tap filters (key, BPM, energy, stars, MyTags, genre) to narrow them.

Needs BACKSPINS/deck-data.tsv on the drive (Backspins' deck export). Reads the drive only: no network, no writes, no change to controls, audio or library.

mods.name: Mala Idea Wallpaper
mods.author: eruizimade
mods.summary: The Mala Idea logo in animated orange ASCII on black, at power-on and when the deck sits idle.
mods.description:
At power-on, and when the deck sits untouched with no deck playing, the Mala Idea logo covers the screen in AZ-MODS orange: the speech bubble's outline in line characters, its inside a slow wave of characters, the letters dense and swept by a band of light, loose grey characters drifting outside.

Press SHIFT twice (either side) to get the deck back; touches while it is up never reach the deck, and a finger held 3 seconds also closes it. In the Mod Menu: switch it off, turn off the power-on screen, set the wait (1 to 30 min) or show it now.

It only draws on the screen. It does not patch the deck's code, change any control, LED or audio, write files, or use the network.
